system.description:
Level 8. Twice per combat.

Recall an active Spirit Beast through its Gate as a Swift Action, removing it from combat and granting a benefit based on which Spirit was recalled:

  • Crimson: Your next Focused Attack deals 10 additional damage.
  • Violet: You gain a Ward equal to the Health the Spirit Beast had when recalled.
  • Azure: Your next Leap has double its vertical and horizontal distance and deals no falling damage.
  • Sage: Until the end of the next Player Phase you become Hyper-Energized (Energized with double its benefit).
